newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Mongolian president arrives for Indonesian visit.
newsitem.headline: Mongolian president arrives for Indonesian visit.

text.p: Mongolian President Punsalmaagiin Ochirbat arrived in Indonesia on Monday on a three-day official visit which will focus on improving trade and economic ties, a government minister said.
State Secretary Murdiono said Ochirbat was scheduled to hold official talks with Indonesian President Suharto on Tuesday.
"The focus of the discussions will be on economic and trade issues," Murdiono told reporters. The two leaders were then expected to sign a joint communique to improve economic ties.
Ochirbat would visit the resort island of Bali on Wednesday before flying to New Zealand.
